rows.details: Indian Institute of Technology Ropar (IIT Ropar)
A Novel Two-in-One Orthobiologic Injectable for Treating Bone Infections and Defects
Three years or up to the termination of project
Must not be more than 30 years as on closing date of application

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must hold a Master’s or PhD Degree in Materials Science, Biochemistry, Biophysics, Lifesciences, Biotechnology, Biomedical Engineering, Pharmacy, or other medical or life science related subjects. The position is open with or without GATE, NET, CSIR-UGC, or other qualifying exams. Applicants must not be more than 30 years old as on the closing date of application, with age relaxation applicable as per the norms or orders of the Government of India. An ideal candidate should possess the following attributes and experience: Understanding of bone or musculoskeletal system Hands-on experience in a wet-lab environment Proficiency in tissue processing, histological work, and designing & executing animal studies Ability to design and execute biomolecular testing protocols Biomedical translational and collaborative acumen Prior clinical interactions or industry experience (preferable)

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected Project Research Scientist – I receives a consolidated salary of Rs. 56,000/- plus 10% HRA per month in accordance with ICMR norms. The project duration is three years or up to the termination of the project, subject to an annual performance review. Candidates may also be considered for alternative opportunities based on their performance on the project.

content_sections.heading: IIT Ropar Project Research Scientist – I Job Description
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will work on a high-impact ICMR-funded project involving IIT Ropar and PGIMER Chandigarh titled “A Novel Two-in-One Orthobiologic Injectable for Treating Bone Infections and Defects”. Responsibilities include tissue processing, histological work, designing and executing animal studies, and designing and executing biomolecular testing protocols within a wet-lab environment.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applications received by the due date will be screened, and only shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview. The interview may be conducted in person or online. No TA or DA will be paid to candidates for attending an in-person interview.
